title: Audio Labelling App Project
description: Project definition. Paths are relative to this file, and may use environment variables as ${NAME}.

label-palette.description: Path to the label palette file. Note that it may be edited and over-written - make sure it is backed up / under version control.

dataset-roots.description: List of read only data set root paths (each root will be searched recursively for audio files

export-prefix.description: Prefix path to export output files, including filename minus extension

channel.description: Channel to view and play, numbered from 1. Default: a mix of all channels. Can be changed per file in the app.

annotations.description: Trees of per-recording label files that mirror the dataset roots, for exchanging labels with other tools: <root>/<path relative to the dataset root, with the label file's extension>

format.description: audacity: start, stop, label (.txt). dcase: onset, offset, event_label (.tsv). raven: a selection table (.Table.1.selections.txt). Default: audacity

naming.description: replace: rec.wav -> rec.txt. append: rec.wav -> rec.wav.txt. Default: replace

import.description: How the files are read. Labels whose text starts with x: are rejected candidates. Default: none (export only)

export.description: Whether the app writes the files. Default: true

export-files.description: done: only files marked done, each written even with no labels, so an empty file means checked with no events. all: also files with labels not marked done. Default: done

include-suggestions.description: Also write suggestions not yet reviewed. Default: false

empty-means-done.description: An empty file marks its recording done on import. Default: true, except for trees imported as suggestions

review.description: How labels are played and shown while checking them. Every key is optional.

view_pre_s.description: Shown before a suggestion in review mode. Default: 0.1

view_post_s.description: Shown after a suggestion's start in review mode. Default: 0.65

snap_window_s.description: How far snapping may move an onset. Default: 0.005

by_score.description: Review the lowest scores first, if suggestions have scores. Default: true

assisted-labellers.description: Detectors that propose suggestions to review: external programs run once per recording, or built-ins. A built-in loudness labeller is listed even if not configured.

command.description: Program and arguments (preferred: no quoting needed), or one string run through cmd.exe or /bin/sh. Placeholders: {audio}, {output} (the label file to write; without it, standard output is read), {relative}, {root}, {project_dir}, {channel}, {class}. It must exit with 0.

format.description: Of what the command writes. Default: audacity

builtin.description: A built-in instead of a command

class.description: Class of a built-in's suggestions. Default: chosen in the app

options.description: Loudness: margin_db (12), min_level_db (-70), floor_percentile (0.2), frame_s (0.01), min_length_s (0.03), merge_gap_s (0.1), padding_s (0.01), onsets (false)

clip-manifest.description: A CSV of clips cut by another tool, to check in the app

clip-root.description: Clip paths are relative to this. Default: the CSV's folder

source.description: The source recording, relative to a dataset root. Default: source_path

onset.description: Onset in the source, in seconds. Default: onset_s

dataset-root.description: The dataset root source paths are relative to, as written in dataset-roots. Default: try each

match_s.description: A label this close to a clip's onset is the clip's label. Default: 0.05

export.description: Clip export settings. Every key is optional.

directory.description: Output directory, relative to this file. Default: dataset

mode.description: padded: each label plus padding, merging labels whose clips would overlap. fixed: a window of fixed length centred on each label. Default: padded

padding_s.description: Padding before and after each label, and the gap kept between background clips and labels. Default: 0.5

fixed_length_s.description: Clip length in fixed mode. Default: 10

max_clip_s.description: Merging stops before a clip would exceed this. Default: 30

background_per_file.description: Clips with no labels, from files marked done. Default: 0
